propositions: Operators lack diagnostic surface to inspect held locks without manual filesystem inspection; rebar doctor must report lock state (held/free/absent), ownership (host/namespace/pid/start time), holder liveness, and hold age.

Doctor must probe four lock legs (tickets write fcntl, tickets write mkdir, hlc fcntl, enrich-drain O_EXCL) using non-blocking techniques inherited from existing lock probes, reporting state and age for each.
Holder liveness must be same-host-only; foreign hosts or pid namespaces report 'unprobeable' rather than guessing pid state.

Staleness determination must use only the single authority lock_owner._mkdir_lock_is_stale with its existing pid-recycle qualification and wall-clock ceiling; no second independent staleness heuristic.
Stale locks produce a finding and exit code 1; held locks with live holders produce no finding and exit 0; doctor is read-only and --repair never touches locks.
JSON output and documentation must be updated to describe the four lock legs, their state vocabulary, liveness verdict, hold age, and staleness classification.
